games.name: [UPD!] Baddies 💅
games.desc:
Mop Baddies, Hang Out, Get Money  

UPDATES every weekend!!  

Controls: 
• E = STOMP: Stomp on down players to whoop them.
• F = PULL HAIR: Charge your blue bar by hitting others and press F to get people bald 
• G = CARRY PEOPLE: Step on a downed player and press G to carry them. 
• Shift = RUN • Fists Tool: Equip your fists to hit people. 

Hitting someone while stepping on someone will mop them. 

IMPORTANT: If you log with 30 HP or less you lose your weapons.  

Game Features: 
• Character Customization: Click the avatar icon in the top-right corner of the screen to customize your Avatar. 
• Get Money: Smash ATMs around the map to collect cash. 
• Pick Up Fight Items: Find various items scattered across the map to use in fights.

games.name: Industrialist
games.desc:
Industrialist is a factory construction and expansion game inspired by Mindustry, Factorio, and other popular industry simulation games.

Key Game Features:
    • Pollution management: Keep track of your pollution level and keep it under control.
    • Production lines: Plan, optimize, and upgrade your manufacturing systems.
    • Economic strategy: Manage money and research new technology.
    • Immersive mechanics: Engage with immersive and modular machine systems.

This game has a steep learning curve and complex mechanics. Getting used to these systems will require a lot of practice, so we recommend playing with friends to share discoveries.

Development Status:
Beta (v1.0). Expect regular updates, possible bugs, and changes while the game is in development.

games.name: Examination
games.desc:
!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900
